articles.title: Bitcoin could test $90,000 after shorts get squeezed, but traders warn leverage is building
articles.snippet: Bitcoin has broken out to $86,000, but analysts say the next leg depends on whether spot buyers continue to show up as leverage builds.

articles.title: Why this investment bank expects little demand for tokenized stocks despite SEC’s new trading rules
articles.snippet: TD Cowen expects limited demand for tokenized stocks despite new SEC rules opening a path for trading outside traditional markets.

articles.title: Crypto political group plans to spend $30 million against Sherrod Brown's Senate bid
articles.snippet: It's the biggest spending from the industry's campaign arm in 2026, much like Fairshake's $40 million against Brown two years ago was its largest-ever outlay.

articles.title: ECB plans to buy tokenized bonds with its own funds
articles.snippet: The European Central Bank rolled out a new system to link its payment system to blockchain-based financial markets.

articles.title: Why banks and offshore hubs like Dubai are winners of the Senate killing the Clarity Act
articles.snippet: One expert believes that the failure to pass the bill is a win for the banks that staunchly oppose stablecoin yields, while a global crypto lawyer believes overseas jurisdictions benefit.
